intent: Switch to one page of a paged result set through state, marking the page in view.
typical_uses: A page number in the row of a pager driven by component state, with the current page marked by isActive

dont_use_when.situation: A page that has its own URL

instead.note: A real anchor keeps the page crawlable and openable in a new tab; use a button only when changing the page leaves the URL alone.

dont_use_when.situation: A button to the previous page
A button to the next page
An action that is not paging

invariants.text: PaginationButton always renders a `button` with `type="button"` unless the consumer passes another `type`, so it never submits a form by accident; every button attribute and handler, `onClick` and `disabled` included, is forwarded to it.

`isActive` sets `aria-current="page"` and `data-active` on the button, and the active paint (pagination.module.css `.link[data-active]`: the --background fill under a --primary label) selects `data-active`; without it neither attribute is rendered.

With `square` on, the button is a fixed var(--control-height-xs) square with no inline padding, and a label wider than that does not grow it; with `square` off it keeps the same height and takes inline padding of var(--space-2), growing with its label.
A `disabled` button is dimmed to var(--opacity-disabled) and takes no pointer events (pagination.module.css `.link:disabled`), and, being a native disabled button, leaves the tab order.

anti_patterns.dont: Mark more than one button as isActive
anti_patterns.do_instead: Set isActive on the one button for the page in view; only one page is current

anti_patterns.dont: Use a button for a page that has its own URL
anti_patterns.do_instead: Use PaginationLink with the page's real href, so the page stays crawlable and can be opened in a new tab

a11y.by: pagination.test.tsx asserts aria-current="page" and data-active="true" with isActive and neither without it, that the element is a button with type "button" and that a disabled one is not focusable

good.title: The current page in a state-driven pager
A page that is out of reach

bad.title: A button for a page that has a URL
bad.why: A button is not a link: it cannot be opened in a new tab or crawled. When the page has its own URL, give PaginationLink that href and intercept the click if the app routes on the client.

cannot_extract: default: prop "type" defaults to "button", but the contract states no property for it - the default is not stated
